title: ProtGPT2: a language model generating novel protein sequences
summary: ProtGPT2, a 738-million-parameter autoregressive transformer trained on UniRef50, generates de novo protein sequences in seconds. The authors report the generated sequences are distantly related to natural ones, sample unexplored regions of protein space, and match natural sequences in amino acid and disorder propensities. Caveat: the evaluation is computational (sequence searches and similarity networks), with no experimental validation in the sources checked.
organization: Center for Genomic Regulation, Barcelona; Universitat Pompeu Fabra
